title: Mixing: Stand By Me by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon mixed ‘Stand By Me’ in stereo for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 4 November 1974.

The song had been recorded on 23 and 24 October. ‘Stand By Me’ was issued as the only single from the album in early 1975.
